reviews.t: Not as expected. Read this before you buy.
reviews.x: The best way I can describe this bonnet is by calling it a mesh satin bonnet (pictures included). Mesh because it's seethrough yet actually silky like satin. Maybe it's that could be the "infused" coconut oil they're trying to hype up. The wide ban is sufficient at staying in place while you sleep which is what I was looking for, but if you have a tender head it may cause headaches due to the tightness. I wanted a satin bonnet to deep condition my hair over night, but that's not possible
I bought this bonnet and instead received a box of sharpies. I don't know how this mistake was made but I'm very irritated.

reviews.t: When I saw this beautiful Bonnet I just had to have it
reviews.x: I decided to get a hair bonnet just because I have been wearing a headscarf for years. When I saw this beautiful Bonnet I just had to have it. Needless to say when it arrived today I was very disappointed. The pic shows a thick, lush bonnet which is NOT what I received. It looks absolutely nothing like the picture and it is not even the same color/material. It is a see through mesh material. I mean for five bucks I wasn't expecting a lot just for it to look like the picture.

I don't know what it is with this cap but it leaves stains on your bed. When I first wore it to sleep, I woke up the following morning to see horrid blue stains on my pillowcase, like it was terrible. All over the pillow case, I hand washed my pillow case, and some of the marks are permanent. I mistakenly left the cap on my bed this afternoon before heading out. I came back to see the same monstrous bluish black stains on my bedsheet. I am so frustrated with this. To think I trusted the reviews

reviews.t: Cheap material, not as advertised in image
reviews.x: The elastic bit should keep it on my head (I'm a rough sleeper, bonnets never last the night with me) but it does not remotely resemble the image. I ordered the purple because the color was very rich and deep and appealing and I thought I was classing up my satin bonnet game. Nope. The elastic band is covered in a completely different material than the rest of the bonnet, which....I do not think this is satin. It's some cheap facsimile of satin. The only positive about this purchase experience i
The band is not any wider than any other bonnet, it’s just thicker. It bleeds horribly into your pillow. I have a red one and a black one and I regret my purchase!!

reviews.t: A cheap imitation of what you expect
reviews.x: The item we received in the mail was not very much like what you see in the photo of this product. The bonnet we got is made of flimsy polyester material that you can see through. It is NOT satin, and is light 'purple-ish' in color. I am going to send it back, and go to my local beauty supply store so I can see what we're buying.

reviews.t: Looks nothing like it does in the picture
reviews.x: Looks nothing like it does in the picture. The cap is extremely sheer and thin. The picture shows a dark red and the cap came bright cherry/orange red! Definitely returning!
It keeps hair moisturized but falls of kind of easy, overall it does its job and i will continue to use it to keep my hair healthy.
Love this bonnet style.  Keeps hair neat overnight, eliminates frizzy flaways and makes perfect hairdos every morning.

Pretty great bonnet I will buy more, i have a small head n it’s pretty snug , the color is nice bonnet is not to too thick so your hair can breathe also it’s silky. Sometimes I put it right on the hair line of my frontals it secures it while I sleep the bonnet doesn’t easily slide off.

reviews.t: Like it a lot! Doesn't slip off my head!
reviews.x: The fabric around the edges was a great idea. I'm a tosser and turner when i sleep and when i had bonnets that had a silk edge, i'd be going on a wild goose chase every morning looking for it because it slipped off my head, not to mention my hair was ruined. Love this cap!

I have a pretty narrow shaped yet, not big. And the bonnet is still too tight. Tight enough to give me a headache so I can't use it. Sucks, but, maybe I just got a big head. Besides that it's okay, nothing special. Breathable and definitely holds your hair in
These caps fit snugly and you don't have to worry about  waking up in the morning without a cap on.

The bonnet I received is definitely not the one pictured. The one in the picture looks thick and the color (I chose purple) is not as rich either.  The material is not even close to looking like the one in the picture. The one I received is very thin and cheap, looks like something you'd find at a dollar store in which case the price here was too much for the quality. Of course if compared to other bonnets being sold here this one is considered inexpensive but for the quality, it's too much. Hop

This is a good cap, except the band is a little too tight at first to fit my big old head. It does stay on, it really does stay on!! My caps usually come off and are all over the bed or on the floor by the middle of the night, not this one, that sucker stayed on through thick braids, my massive amount of curls, twists, and sleeping bad, this thing did not move at all. The only thing was that because the band is so tight, it left a line on my forehead, but I can deal with that to keep a cap on al

reviews.t: While the cap gives enough volume to fit in the ...
reviews.x: While the cap gives enough volume to fit in the hair, the elastic part is too tight and uncomfortably squeezes my head. I am only hoping it will stretch over time as my other bonnet did, but I am worried about being able to sleep while its still new and overly tight. I am not worried about thin fabric as I only use bonnet to keep my curls and hair style which is not compromised by thinness. Will not re-order this product as it is not worth it's price.

This product was fine the first night I used it- it stayed in place really well and was comfortable. After using it for about three nights, the elastic became stretched out and now it's too big and doesn't stay on my head during the night. Also, the material is a polyester satin which isn't the best for hair (you should be using a silk satin). I'm going to toss this cap as soon as I buy a better one that fits better and has a better quality material.

The band on this is so tight, I can’t wear it but for a few minutes. There is no way i could sleep in this thing.  It won’t even stay in one Place.  It’s so tight, it rides up.  My head is average size.  It’s too bad.  I really was hoping this was going to be the one I was looking for.

Bought this to wear at night . I have very thick curly hair and it's just past my shoulders it look a little bit of effort but got it all in the cap. The band does squeeze some  but it's my first time using it .I feel it's something I will enjoy having.
It was rough and the band was extremely tight. It gave me a migrain and my hair was a big ball of frizz the next morning. I do not recommend for textured hair, tight curl or coils.

reviews.t: Cheap, you get what you pay for
reviews.x: Cheap, you can see right through the material. The band is nice but size is more of a child size. Not worth spending money to return it SMDH

reviews.x: when give you an headache too tight....elastic around the edge. you must not have a large head or a lot of hair.

reviews.t: A waste of money poor quality extremely large something you can ...
reviews.x: A waste of money poor quality extremely large something you can purchase on the $.99 store
It the picture the material looks thicker. When I got it looks cheap. Won’t buy again.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the bonnet looks nothing like the product photo, describing it as thin, sheer, and cheap-looking rather than thick and lush.
Several reviewers report the bonnet bleeds or leaves stains on pillowcases.
Some reviewers say the bonnet stays securely on the head and doesn't slip off overnight.
A few reviewers say it keeps hair moisturized, neat, and frizz-free.
Some reviewers find the fit too tight or note it falls off easily.
